title: Weststar delivers first AW139 helicopter to JBPM under government concession
summary: Stakeholders celebrated the official handover and operational launch of the first Leonardo AW139 helicopter for the Fire and Rescue Department of Malaysia (JBPM).
body_markdown:
The Weststar Group, through Weststar Aviation Sdn Bhd, marked a significant milestone in its strategic partnership with the Government of Malaysia with the official handover and operational launch of the first Leonardo[AW139](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/leonardo/aw139) helicopter for the Fire and Rescue Department of Malaysia (JBPM) under the Government Helicopter Leasing Concession Agreement.


The ceremony was officiated by Minister of Housing and Local Government YB Tuan Nga Kor Ming and attended by His Excellency Raffaele Langella, Ambassador of Italy to Malaysia; YBhg Datuk Wira Dr. M Noor Azman Taib, Secretary-General of the Ministry of Housing and Local Government; YAS Dato’ Sri Ts. Nor Hisham Mohammad, Director-General of JBPM; YBhg Datuk Muhammad Razman Abu Samah, Director-General of the Public Private Partnership Unit (UKAS); YBhg Brigadier General Samsuri Abu Bakar TUDM, Director-General of the Directorate General Technical Airworthiness; YBrs Tuan Badrul Shah Mohd Idris, Deputy Director-General of National Security (Security Management); YBhg Tan Sri Dr Syed Azman Syed Ibrahim, Group Managing Director of The Weststar Group; and YBhg Tan Sri Dato’ Haji Ahmad Johan, Chairman of AIROD Sdn Bhd.


Weststar Photo


The delivery represents the first aircraft to enter operational service under the concession agreement signed between the Government of Malaysia and Weststar Aviation Sdn Bhd in December 2024, which came into effect on June 16, 2025. Under the agreement, Weststar will supply a total of 28 helicopters to various government agencies over a three-year period.


Speaking at the ceremony, YB Nga Kor Ming highlighted the financial benefits of the leasing arrangement, stating that the government is expected to save approximately RM3 billion through the 28-helicopter concession compared with the traditional procurement approach.


He explained that the leasing model also places responsibility for aircraft maintenance on the concessionaire throughout the 15-year concession period, reducing the government’s direct maintenance burden while ensuring continued access to essential aviation assets.


The addition of two[AW139](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/leonardo/aw139) helicopters will further strengthen JBPM’s operational capabilities, supporting search-and-rescue (SAR), firefighting, medical evacuation, transportation of patients and remains, as well as the delivery of essential logistical assistance during emergencies and disasters.


Achieving operational readiness approximately 11 months after the signing of the agreement underscores Weststar’s ability to mobilize resources, coordinate with multiple stakeholders and deliver mission-critical aviation assets within a structured timeframe.


The[AW139](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/leonardo/aw139) has been configured to meet JBPM’s operational requirements and has successfully completed the pre-delivery inspection (PDI) and final acceptance test (FAT) conducted by the concessionaire and JBPM. The aircraft is now ready to support the department’s search-and-rescue, emergency response and disaster relief operations.


Speaking at the ceremony, chief executive officer of Weststar Aviation Sdn Bhd, General Tan Sri Muhammad Ismail Jamaluddin, said the delivery reflected the Group’s commitment to supporting the government’s efforts to strengthen the operational capabilities of its agencies through strategic public-private partnerships.


“The government’s trust in Weststar is not merely a contractual commitment; it is a responsibility that we take very seriously. We recognize that these helicopters are more than aviation assets. They are essential operational resources that can make a critical difference when lives are at stake.


“From the signing of the agreement to the operational deployment of the first helicopter in approximately 11 months, this achievement reflects the collective commitment and close coordination between the Government, JBPM, Leonardo Helicopters and our teams at Weststar.


“We remain committed to delivering safe, reliable and mission-ready aircraft, supported by a high level of operational availability, to ensure that the agencies entrusted with protecting the public have the capabilities they need,” he said.


Weststar Photo


The Government Helicopter Leasing Concession adopts a long-term leasing arrangement under which the provision, maintenance and support of the helicopters are undertaken by the concessionaire throughout the concession period.


This model enables government agencies to access modern aviation assets while reducing the need for substantial upfront capital expenditure and placing long-term maintenance responsibilities within an integrated support arrangement.


The concession will serve several government agencies, strengthening the country’s aviation capabilities across defence, security, law enforcement, firefighting and emergency response operations.


The first JBPM[AW139](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/leonardo/aw139) also represents the beginning of a phased delivery program. The second[AW139](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/leonardo/aw139) helicopter for JBPM is scheduled to arrive in Malaysia by the end of November 2026, with operational deployment targeted for mid-December 2026, ahead of the peak monsoon season.


The successful delivery is the result of close collaboration between Weststar Aviation Services, Leonardo Helicopters, the National Security Council (MKN), the Public Private Partnership Unit (UKAS) and JBPM, alongside the technical and operational teams involved in the programme.


Weststar also acknowledges the support and cooperation of AIROD Sdn Bhd and other industry stakeholders in advancing the country’s aviation capabilities.


As a leading Malaysian aviation services provider, Weststar Aviation Services brings extensive experience in helicopter operations, maintenance and aviation support.


The Group’s longstanding collaboration with international aviation manufacturers and government agencies further reinforces its commitment to developing sustainable aviation capabilities and delivering operational excellence.


With the first aircraft now entering service, Weststar remains focused on the timely delivery of the remaining helicopters under the concession, reinforcing its role as a strategic partner in supporting the Government’s long-term operational requirements and national public safety priorities.


*This press release was prepared and distributed by Weststar.*
